displayNameCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的贝阿特丽丝
fullNameCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的贝阿特丽丝
sourceNote: Daughter of Herbert I of Vermandois and mother of Hugh the Great; wife of Robert I of France.
notes: Her descent from the Carolingian line is through her father. Married c. 890 as the second wife of Robert of Neustria (later King Robert I); ancestress of the Capetian dynasty through her son Hugh the Great. Died after 26 March 931.

deathCause.detail: Béatrice's last known attestation is 26 March 931; she died after that date, but the exact year, place and circumstances are not documented.
deathCause.detailCn: 贝阿特丽丝最后一次见于记载是931年3月26日；她在此之后去世，但确切年份、地点与情形均无记载。

events.label: Birth of Béatrice of Vermandois (c. 880)
events.labelCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的贝阿特丽丝出生（约880年）
events.note: Born c. 880; exact date and place unknown.

events.label: Marriage to Robert of Neustria
events.labelCn: 与纽斯特里亚的罗贝尔成婚
events.note: Married c. 890 as the second wife of Robert of Neustria, who later reigned as King Robert I of France (922-923).

events.label: Became Queen of the Franks
events.note: Robert was elected king in 922; Béatrice was queen consort 922-923.

events.label: Robert I killed at the Battle of Soissons
events.labelCn: 罗贝尔一世在苏瓦松之战中阵亡
events.note: Her husband was killed on 15 June 923; their son Hugh the Great was offered the crown but refused. Béatrice was left a widow.

events.label: Death of Béatrice of Vermandois (after 931)
events.labelCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的贝阿特丽丝去世（931年之后）
events.note: Last attested 26 March 931; died after that date, exact date unknown.

displayNameCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的赫伯特一世
fullNameCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦伯爵赫伯特一世
sourceNote: Son of Pepin of Vermandois and father of Béatrice of Vermandois.
notes: Carolingian male-line descendant through Pepin of Italy. Count of Vermandois and Soissons; his dates of accession vary by source (text: before 889; infobox: 893; existing record: 896). His capture and murder of his brother Raoul in 896 may have led Baldwin II of Flanders to have him killed in 907 (speculative).

deathCause.summary: Possibly assassinated on Baldwin II's orders
deathCause.detail: Herbert died in 907. Some historians speculate that Baldwin II of Flanders had him assassinated, possibly in retaliation for Herbert's capture and murder of his own brother Raoul in 896; the accounts are uncertain, and no battle or natural cause is recorded.
deathCause.detailCn: 赫伯特于907年去世。有史家推测他是被佛兰德伯爵鲍德温二世派人暗杀的，可能与896年赫伯特俘杀亲兄弟拉乌尔一事有关；此说尚不确定，史料亦未记载战斗或自然死亡。

events.label: Became Count of Vermandois and Soissons
events.labelCn: 成为韦尔芒杜瓦与苏瓦松伯爵
events.note: Accession date uncertain: Wikipedia text says before 889, the infobox gives 893, the existing record uses 896.

events.label: Capture and murder of his brother Raoul
events.note: Herbert captured his brother Raoul in the upper Somme valley and had him murdered rather than ransomed; some historians link this to his own later death.

events.label: Death of Herbert I
events.note: Died 907; possibly assassinated on the orders of Baldwin II of Flanders (speculative).

sourceNote: Son of Bernard of Italy and ancestor of the Vermandois branch.
notes: Often styled Pepin I of Vermandois in genealogical references. Son of Bernard of Italy and great-grandson of Charlemagne; held Vermandois, Senlis, Péronne and Saint-Quentin. NOTE: this is Pepin I, who died c. 850 (after 850 in some genealogies) — not Pepin II (d. c. 893) nor the 'after 922' figure. Death year corrected from 845 to c. 850 per Wikipedia.

deathCause.detail: Pepin died c. 850 (some genealogies say after 850). No violent or suspicious circumstances are recorded; the exact date and cause are not documented.
deathCause.detailCn: 丕平约于850年去世（部分谱系记载为850年之后）。史料未记载暴力或可疑的情形，确切日期与死因均无记载。

events.label: Birth of Pepin of Vermandois (c. 815)
events.labelCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的丕平出生（约815年）
events.note: Born c. 815 (Wikipedia infobox: c. 817); exact date unknown.

events.label: Count of Vermandois, Senlis, Péronne and Saint-Quentin
events.labelCn: 任韦尔芒杜瓦、桑利、佩罗讷与圣康坦伯爵
events.note: Date of succession uncertain; Wikipedia notes his son Pepin II held the county from 850.

events.label: Supported Emperor Lothar after Louis the Pious's death
events.labelCn: 虔诚者路易去世后支持皇帝洛泰尔
events.note: Despite earlier allegiance to Charles the Bald, Pepin supported Emperor Lothar in the succession struggle after Louis the Pious died (840).

events.label: Death of Pepin of Vermandois
events.labelCn: 韦尔芒杜瓦的丕平去世
events.note: Died c. 850 (some sources: after 850); exact date unknown.
